messages:
jess: Heads-up — since ~02:10 UTC we've seen ~30% of model pulls fail in apac-prod; pods stuck in ImagePullBackOff with NXDOMAIN for model-registry.internal.redwood.svc.
omar: saw that, also seeing downloads from s3-proxy time out, logs show DNS lookups intermittently REFUSED and some truncated responses.
lee: suspect split-horizon + search path. APAC edge returns internal VIP for registry when inside VPC, but egress SNAT IPs hit our external view. ndots + search path is causing extra queries to the public resolver.
sara: on a couple nodes /etc/resolv.conf has 'options ndots:5' but containers show 'ndots:1' — kubelet --resolv-conf change during last week's rollout might be inconsistent across nodes.
jess: we also rolled node-local-dns last night; its local cache negative-ttl seems set to 30s and I can see rapid eviction + re-resolve storms.
omar: syslog shows systemd-resolved truncating UDP EDNS0 responses (TC bit set). I think DNS TCP fallback is getting blocked by our SNAT+iptables rules. tcpdump pointed to truncated UDP, then no TCP fallback.
sara: can someone run this on a failing node to confirm?
```bash
sudo tcpdump -n -s0 -vv port 53 | grep -i "Truncated" || true
```
lee: quick manual mitigation: restart node-local-dns daemonset and recycle a model-puller pod to force a fresh lookup: 
```bash
kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart daemonset/node-local-dns
kubectl -n apac-prod delete pod -l app=model-puller
```
jess: did that on one affected node — model pulls recovered after ~40s, but retry storms pushed the apac egress NAT node's conntrack to 98% and we started seeing packet drops.
omar: temporarily bumped conntrack: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288` on the NAT host and the drops stopped, but that's not a permanent fix.
sara: long-term actions we should take: align ndots across host/pods, enable TCP fallback in CoreDNS forward plugin, tune node-local-dns negative cache TTL, and add pre-warm hooks for critical model artifacts so we don't cause egress bursts on failure.
lee: also note the cost impact: retries + re-downloads spiked APAC egress charges ~18% in the last hour. Need rate-limiting and backoff in the model-puller. :money_with_wings: 
jess: proposed next steps — 1) capture tcpdump + coreDNS/core-local logs on 3 affected nodes (omar/lee) 2) rotate node-local-dns and patch negative-ttl (sara) 3) increase NAT conntrack & expand SNAT pool on APAC egress as short-term (infra team) 4) plan kubelet resolvConf ndots roll to sync host/pod behaviour and update runbook for cache flush.
infra-bot: incident created: INC-APAC-DNS-2026-03-18 (#1234) — paging oncall.
dan: I'm oncall, joining now. I'll coordinate with network and infra, take ownership of the mitigation playbook and loop in billing for the egress cost spike. :thumbsup:
